references.text: Moses also warns Israel against forgetting the covenant with the Lord and against worshiping idols
Moses warns that the Lord's anger will flare up if they turn to other gods, and they will quickly perish from the good land
The curses that will come upon Israel if they break the covenant with the Lord and do not obey his commands
Explanation of why the Lord will punish the land when they abandon the covenant and worship other gods
The Lord predicts that the people will break the covenant and turn to foreign gods, and his anger will flare up against them
Joshua says that Israel has sinned by breaking the covenant, and therefore they cannot stand against their enemies
Joshua warns the people that the Lord will turn against them and do harm if they abandon him and worship foreign gods
Israel abandoned the Lord and served Baal, and the Lord's anger flared up against them so that they could not stand against their enemies
Solomon followed other gods, and the Lord was angry with him because he had broken the covenant
Israel rejected the Lord's covenant and served other gods, and the Lord became angry and removed them from his sight
